notes:
- Company snapshot: mid-market SaaS that powers product search for SMB e-commerce merchants. They operate a multi-tenant search service and are sensitive to tail latency and cost.
- Primary ask: reranking endpoint that can be called as a scoring layer after candidate retrieval. They want both online low-latency rerank and an offline batch scorer for nightly replays.
- Latency/throughput targets: online rerank p95 <60ms (target), typical QPS ~150-250 during peak, offline reranker ~100k docs/day.
- Quality targets: NDCG@10 uplift 8-12% vs current LambdaMART baseline; want per-query QA and sample failure analysis.
- Eval sets: shared 15k query eval set (click logs + 5k human-labeled pairs). Offline scoring job will replay 30 days of traffic for regression testing.
- POC plan: 2-week Hosted API POC to validate scoring latency and quality. If staged results meet criteria, move to Dedicated trial for predictable tail latency and KV cache persistence.
- Security: Require SSO/SAML for admin console, audit logging retained 12 months, US-only data residency. SOC2 evidence required before procurement. KMS integration requested but not mandatory for POC.
- Routing/fallback: want automatic fallback to smaller quantized model or cached results under load; priority is availability over slightly higher cost.
- Pricing sensitivity: mid-market budget; open to 6-12 month committed Dedicated contract if unit economics justified. Interested in burst credit pricing for holiday peaks.
- Quotes from customer: VP Product Aisha Malik - "Need <60ms p95 or we can't move live; users notice the search jitter." CTO Ben Liu - "We will run offline re-ranker nightly and want logs for every scored query for debugging."
- Action items: AE to send Dedicated pricing bands (week of 2026-03-09). SE to provide end-to-end eval harness and baseline comparison; deliver perf report by 2026-03-20. Security to respond with SOC2 artifact package. Procurement to open PO once SOC2 confirmation received.
- Notes style: shorthand, action-focused, include links above.
